scope: One budget domain; NAM-requested native backing extents, not process RSS or allocator-private overhead.
consistency: CaptureStatistics takes the existing domain gate once. Values describe one completed transition; separate captures are not one transaction.
resetPolicy: No reset API. Gauges fall as actual obligations end; identities, configuration, peaks and histories survive owner cleanup for the lifetime of the budget.
availability: Every field in this schema is implemented and available. A zero is an observed count or invariant, never an unavailable private-runtime measurement.
unreviewedScope: Other diagnostic schemas, trace payload semantics, public API/lifecycle contracts and the complete 0.3.0 performance/platform/release boundary remain open. This file is not global completion evidence.

fields.name: Id
fields.definition: Positive immutable budget lineage; not an address and not a separately owned resource.
fields.overflow: Construction throws before wrapping identity; existing budgets remain usable.

fields.name: CapacityBytes
fields.definition: Immutable nonnegative ceiling on committed plus reserved NAM-requested native extents.
fields.overflow: Admission subtracts existing nonnegative charges from the ceiling; checked input conversion cannot wrap.

fields.name: CommittedBytes
fields.definition: Complete successfully acquired backing extents, including prepared-unpublished, retained, retired and detached storage until actual release. Realloc replaces the previous extent exactly once.
fields.overflow: Exact nonnegative gauge bounded by CapacityBytes, independent of saturated event histories.

fields.name: ReservedBytes
fields.definition: Admitted extents awaiting acquisition or cancellation. Ordinary failed acquisition rolls back; application preparation failure preserves pending permission for retry. Cancellation without acquisition is not a physical free or a failed allocation.
fields.overflow: Exact nonnegative gauge; committed plus reserved cannot exceed CapacityBytes.

fields.name: PeakCommittedBytes
fields.definition: Lifetime maximum known committed extent after successful acquisition or replacement. Does not claim an opaque backend realloc transient peak or process RSS.
fields.overflow: Exact maximum bounded by CapacityBytes; cleanup does not reset it.

fields.name: PeakAdmittedBytes
fields.definition: Lifetime maximum committed plus reserved extent, including conservative admission of the full replacement alongside the old extent. Refusal does not raise it; admitted failure can.
fields.overflow: Exact maximum bounded by CapacityBytes; failed or cancelled admission does not reset it.

fields.name: AllocationCount
fields.definition: Fresh nonempty backing acquisitions, including successful realloc from null and application prepared backing. Does not count reusing already charged storage, failed acquisition, or replacing nonempty backing by realloc.
fields.overflow: Saturates at Int64.MaxValue. A further event sets HistoryOverflowed; current allocation gauges remain exact.

fields.name: ReallocationCount
fields.definition: Successful backing realloc calls, including realloc from null; refused or failed attempts are excluded. Not a count of logical size changes within existing backing.
fields.overflow: Saturates at Int64.MaxValue with HistoryOverflowed on a further event; replacement charge and ownership remain correct.

fields.name: FreeCount
fields.definition: Actual physical backing releases. Application cancellation without acquired backing and backing replacement by realloc are not extra frees.
fields.overflow: Saturates at Int64.MaxValue with HistoryOverflowed on a further event; physical release cannot be blocked by history exhaustion.

fields.name: AcquiredBackingBytes
fields.definition: Lifetime sum of full successful fresh nonempty backing requests, including realloc from null and application-prepared backing. Release does not subtract history; retained reuse, zero extents, pending/cancelled permission and failed/refused acquisition add none. This is not backend-private allocation volume or RSS.
fields.overflow: Nonthrowing saturation at Int64.MaxValue; a further positive byte sets HistoryOverflowed. Charges and release remain exact. No reset.

fields.name: ReplacementBackingBytes
fields.definition: Lifetime sum of full target extents of successful reallocations of previously nonempty backing. Not net growth or bytes newly allocated inside opaque realloc. Disjoint from AcquiredBackingBytes; realloc from null contributes only to acquisition bytes.
fields.overflow: Nonthrowing saturation at Int64.MaxValue with HistoryOverflowed on lost exactness; replacement state, charge and cleanup do not depend on history.

fields.name: ActiveAllocationCount
fields.definition: Exact live nonempty backing allocation count. Admission alone adds none; replacing nonempty backing preserves one; successful realloc from null adds one; physical release removes one.
fields.overflow: Each active allocation charges at least one byte; CapacityBytes bounds the exact gauge independently of saturated histories.

fields.name: RejectedAllocationCount
fields.definition: Requests refused before native acquisition because the budget cannot admit the minimum extent, including application permissions. Accepting a smaller permitted growth preference is not a refusal.
fields.overflow: Saturates at Int64.MaxValue with HistoryOverflowed on a further refusal; expected exhaustion remains nonallocating.

fields.name: FailedAllocationCount
fields.definition: Ordinary admitted acquisition rollback and actual application backend failures. Application backend failure can preserve pending admission for retry. Permission cancellation alone and preparation metadata failure before backend acquisition are not fabricated backend failures.
fields.overflow: Saturates at Int64.MaxValue with HistoryOverflowed on a further event; rollback still releases the admission charge.

fields.name: TraceCapacity
fields.definition: Fixed preallocated ring size. Zero disables event construction, not budget histories or gauges.
fields.overflow: Int32 nonnegative constructor input; allocation failure throws, never reports a fabricated ring.

fields.name: TraceCount
fields.definition: Events currently copyable from the bounded ring, not the lifetime event total. Short copies select the newest chronological suffix and do not consume or reset this gauge.
fields.overflow: Exact bounded gauge no greater than TraceCapacity; sequence exhaustion prevents new entries without destroying retained ones.

fields.name: DroppedTraceEventCount
fields.definition: Enabled events overwritten by a full ring or not recorded after sequence exhaustion. Disabled tracing deliberately records neither events nor drops; a short copy is not a drop.
fields.overflow: Saturates at Int64.MaxValue; an additional drop sets TraceOverflowed and makes the count a lower bound.

fields.name: TraceOverflowed
fields.definition: Sticky disclosure that an enabled event sequence could not advance or a dropped-event history could not remain exact. Ordinary bounded overwriting below Int64.MaxValue is not identity exhaustion.
fields.overflow: Sticky true; diagnostic exhaustion never wraps identity or breaks backing acquisition/release.

fields.name: HistoryOverflowed
fields.definition: Sticky budget-domain event/byte history saturation disclosure, including application-admission histories. A counter reaching exactly Int64.MaxValue is still exact until additional positive history occurs; current gauges are unaffected.
fields.overflow: Sticky true; saturated histories become lower bounds without preventing admission reconciliation or physical cleanup.
